data.title: Indian VCs turn to US AI startups in search of bigger returns - The Economic Times
data.ai_summary: Indian VC firms including Peak XV Partners, NuVentures, DeVC, and Activate are increasingly investing in US-based AI startups founded by non-Indians, seeking higher returns amid limited opportunities in India's AI sector. In 2025, Peak XV Partners invested in more than 10 US-based AI startups such as Supabase and PostHog, while NuVentures directed approximately 90% of its investments toward US AI companies. Investors cited insufficient innovative AI companies in India capable of delivering outsized returns, prompting firms to expand their US presence and compete against marquee US investors.
